title: Forest Distraction Rate Spike
dataSources: RescueTime activity (`rescuetime:activity`), Apple/Android screen-time exports (`screentime:usage`), GitHub events (`github:personal`), habit-tracker logs (`habit:entry`), calendar/todo exports.
app: Screen-time / RescueTime exports, GitHub personal activity, habit/journal trackers, and calendar feeds via HEC scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=forest:session
eval distract_rate=distraction_count/focus_min
where distract_rate>0.2
description: Flags Forest sessions with high distraction frequency.
value: Surfacing forest distraction rate spike helps you act before small issues become habits.
implementation: Ingest the relevant digital life & productivity export into `index=personal` and schedule this search weekly.
visualization: Table or chart of key fields.
grandmaExplanation: It brings back when forest distraction rate spike matters for your routine.
